headline: As of 2026-09-22: 86,944 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 6 of 50 states, D+50.1 registration lean.
bullets: 86,944 early/mail ballots cast so far across 6 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+50.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (65,527), Wisconsin (9,654), North Carolina (7,445).
